# Isaiah Chapter 51 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 23 verses]*

*Look to Abraham; comfort for Zion; Rahab cut in pieces; awake; cup of staggering removed*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. This chapter look to abraham.

*-- LOGOS*
